Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

The Beaugrenelle shopping-centre esplanade ('dalle Beaugrenelle') has seen recurring evening group brawls: French outlets reported a fight in early October 2024 that left three people injured, one seriously, with three arrests, and coverage explicitly described it as 'a new' violent incident on the same esplanade, implying it was not an isolated event. This is localized to the Beaugrenelle complex rather than the whole quartier, so daytime and the wider Grenelle area remain low-concern. Sources checked: CNews, 'Paris : une rixe fait trois blessés dont un grave dans le 15e arrondissement', ~5 October 2024; France Bleu / ICI, 'Un mineur blessé, trois arrestations après un affrontement sur la dalle Beaugrenelle à Paris', October 2024; Laminute.info, 'Une nouvelle rixe violente à Beaugrenelle dans le 15e a fait trois blessés', October 2024.

This specific area was reviewed against credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — and the signals were consolidated across sources rather than taken from any single report, with the reasoning and the sources shown above. Paris publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does publish one, Wandroz uses it instead of an assessment. Where a review finds nothing documented, that is recorded as no findings rather than as a safety rating.

Frequently asked questions

Is Grenelle (15e arr.) safe?

Wandroz currently rates Grenelle (15e arr.) in Paris as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Paris during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Paris at night. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. Paris publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does, Wandroz uses it instead.

Is Grenelle (15e arr.) safe at night?

At night, Grenelle (15e arr.) is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Paris. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Grenelle (15e arr.) a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Grenelle (15e arr.)'s day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Paris) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
